snippet.title: Ragnarok: The New World｜First Global Full Gameplay Trailer Released
snippet.description:
Remember the days we met under the Prontera sky? Fought side by side against Angelings? Sat together in the South Gate, sharing stories that became memories?
That feeling is back. But this time, it’s bigger, deeper and more alive.
Step into the first open-world Ragnarok — where every path is yours to choose, every season changes the world around you, and every corner holds a new adventure. 
This is more than a game; it’s a homecoming. New friends, new bonds, a new world awaits. Welcome to Ragnarok: The New World!
#RagnarokTheNewWorld #ROWorld #Ragnarok #ROW #ASPD193
